paragraphs.text: The Necrobloom is a legendary plant from an unknown plane.

The Necrobloom debut in Modern Horizons 3 on the eponymous named The Necrobloom . Its appearance is a large, green pitcher-like plant, rising to nearly the size of an adult human . The plant is cylindrical with a large opening on top surrounded by leaves. Roots are sticking from its bottom in the ground, and several vines that rise from its body can seemingly move. Its roots and vines appear to wrap around the dead, raising them as zombies .
